subject: MAP: Vendor onboarding / procurement steps (FintechCo) - draft & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechco.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Vendor onboarding / procurement steps (FintechCo) - draft & next steps

Hi Liam — great call today, thanks for the time. Per our discovery, procurement is the main gating item for the contract close and you mentioned FintechCo uses Coupa for vendor onboarding.

Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that calls out the vendor onboarding / procurement milestones we discussed: Coupa/Ariba setup, vendor forms, W-9, banking details, and procurement sign-off. High level ask: can you confirm the procurement contact and the target date for vendor onboarding (so I can align Redwood's finance/legal deliverables)?

Quick summary of proposed milestones (full details in attached MAP):
- Procure: Confirm vendor profile and create Coupa profile — owner: FintechCo Procurement — target: 2026-07-15
- Customer: Complete vendor forms (Coupa template) + W-9 — owner: FintechCo Finance — target: 2026-07-10
- Redwood: Provide vendor profile, W-9 template (signed), bank details — owner: Redwood Finance — target: 2026-06-28
- All: Procurement sign-off / vendor approved — target: 2026-07-20

Dependencies: security questionnaire completion (we'll share SOC2 artifacts once NDA is in place), timely receipt of W-9 and banking details, and Coupa onboarding slot availability.

Next steps I propose: you confirm procurement contact and target onboarding date; we'll update the MAP and include the procurement-facing packet (vendor profile + payment remittance instructions). Happy to join a 30-min vendor onboarding call with your procurement if helpful.

Attachments: MAP-Deal-2026-0482-draft.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Vendor onboarding / procurement steps (FintechCo) - draft & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the MAP draft. Confirming procurement contact below: Sandra Miller (procurement lead) is copied. We do use Coupa for vendor onboarding.

A few notes from our side:
- Target: procurement has an onboarding window and the earliest they can get new vendors fully onboarded is by 2026-07-15, assuming we receive all required docs (W-9, bank details) this week.
- We'll need Redwood's vendor profile (company address, tax ID, primary contact, invoice remittance email) to create the Coupa profile.
- Legal will throw a quick vendor agreement redline if necessary; we typically run procurement & legal in parallel.

Sandra — can you confirm the Coupa vendor form (attached in procurement portal) and whether you need any additional vendor docs?

Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Partnerships | FintechCo
liam.oconnor@fintechco.com

Subject: RE: MAP: Vendor onboarding / procurement steps (FintechCo) - draft & next steps

Perfect — thanks Liam and hi Sandra. I've updated the MAP with the procurement contact and adjusted dates to match the 7/15 onboarding window. Key updates are below and in the attached MAP (MAP-Deal-2026-0482-draft.pdf):

Updated MAP milestones (owners & target dates):
1) Redwood: Send vendor profile (company address, tax ID, primary contact, invoice remittance email) + signed W-9 + bank remit details — owner: Redwood Finance (Marissa/Finance Ops) — target: 2026-06-28 — dependency: internal finance sign-off
2) FintechCo: Create Coupa vendor profile & submit vendor form — owner: FintechCo Procurement (Sandra) — target: 2026-07-10 — dependency: receipt of Redwood docs
3) FintechCo: Complete any procurement/legal review & approve vendor — owner: FintechCo Legal/Procurement — target: 2026-07-15
4) All: Go-live & invoice processing enabled — target: 2026-07-20

Attachments included: MAP-Deal-2026-0482-draft.pdf, W9-FintechCo.pdf (blank for your reference), Coupa-Vendor-Form.xlsx (our suggested mapping).

Sandra — can you confirm whether FintechCo needs the W-9 signed before creating the Coupa profile, or if a placeholder W-9 is acceptable to kick off the Coupa entry? Also, is there a preferred invoice remittance method (ACH details vs. stable vendor email)? If helpful, Camila and I can join a 30-minute procurement session this week to walk through the Coupa fields (we typically have a quick mapping call).

Next actions I will take from Redwood's side:
- Circulate signed Redwood W-9 and vendor profile to you by EOD 6/28.
- Provide a short vendor packet (1-pager) that explains Redwood's billing cadence and remittance instructions.
- Stand by for any legal redlines; we'll escalate to our legal team if needed.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. Two quick technical notes for procurement to avoid back-and-forth when filling Coupa fields:

1) Invoice remit: we prefer ACH with an invoice_remit@redwood.com mailbox; we can provide bank details once NDA/PO is in place. If FintechCo requires a specific remittance format in Coupa, please flag the exact field name and we'll map it in the packet.

2) Tax ID: please use Redwood Inference, EIN: 26-1234567, and company legal address: 1234 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103. (We will include these in the vendor profile attachment.)

If Sandra is available, Camila and I can host a 30-min Coupa mapping call tomorrow (6/22) at 10:00 AM PT to speed onboarding. Otherwise we'll proceed with the packet and signed W-9 by EOD 6/28 as Marissa noted.

Camila Reyes
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
